verdict: Meta is working; Google's spend needs to justify itself fast.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 26 leads at an average cost of $157.97 per lead — all 26 came through Meta, which is running efficiently on its own spend. Google Ads consumed $2,581.74 over the same window and produced 2 conversions, a cost per conversion above $1,290 with no prior baseline to support it; that spend is under active review. On the positive side, lead volume is up 33% and cost per lead is down 7% comparing the most recent 7 days to the prior 7 days, pointing in the right direction. Your pipeline shows 105 opportunities created this period but no appointments recorded, which suggests leads are entering the system but stalling before a meeting is booked — that is a follow-up process issue, not an ads issue, and we are working through it with you. Next period, expect a clearer read on Google's role as we restructure that spend and tighten intake.

watch_item.fix: That campaign's structure and targeting are being reviewed this week to either demonstrate returns or reallocate spend toward what is working.
